mrv_findings.text: confidence=75 severity=P1 app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90 — "group.users.delete(user_id)" — ActiveRecord collection deletion expects a User record rather than a bare integer ID, so the new remove-member endpoint can raise an association type error instead of removing the membership.

confidence=100 severity=P1 app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — "limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i" — The public members page now fetches only 50 users, but the changed public route/template adds no pagination controls, making every member after the first page inaccessible.

confidence=100 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — "return Math.floor(this.get(\"user_count\") / this.get(\"limit\")) + 1;" — Exact multiples of the page size produce a nonexistent extra page, so a 50-member group advertises page 2 and navigates to an empty result.

confidence=75 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:64 — "this.get(\"model\").addMembers(this.get(\"usernames\"));" — Membership add failures are neither returned nor handled, leaving the administrator with no error feedback and no reliable indication whether the requested change succeeded.

confidence=75 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:56 — "self.get(\"model\").removeMember(member);" — Membership removal failures are neither returned nor handled after confirmation, so rejected removals silently leave stale membership state.

confidence=100 severity=P3 app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/user-selector-autocomplete.raw.hbs:5 — "<a href='#'>{{avatar this imageSize=\"tiny\"}}" — Reformatting the shared autocomplete template changes code outside the group-membership behavior and adds unrelated review surface with no traceability to the stated task.

confidence=100 severity=P1 app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6:11 — "model.findMembers();" — The public members view now fetches only the API's default 50-member page but exposes no pagination path, so every member after the first 50 becomes unreachable.

confidence=100 severity=P1 app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — "render json: {" — The established members endpoint changes from a bare serialized array to an unversioned `{members, meta}` object, breaking existing API and plugin consumers that iterate the top-level response.

confidence=100 severity=P1 app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:38 — "group.visible = params[:visible] == \"true\"" — Any partial update or legacy PATCH that omits `visible` silently changes the group to invisible while updating an unrelated field.

confidence=100 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — "return Math.floor(this.get(\"user_count\") / this.get(\"limit\")) + 1;" — Exact multiples of the page size produce a phantom extra page, allowing navigation to an empty result page.

confidence=100 severity=P2 app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — "limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i" — An unbounded, unvalidated client limit permits arbitrarily large result materialization, while zero or negative values create invalid pagination semantics.

confidence=100 severity=P2 app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — "usernames.split(\",\").each do |username|" — Bulk membership addition performs a user lookup and association operation per supplied username, creating an unbounded N+1 write path instead of a batched lookup/write.

confidence=100 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:21 — "if (Em.isEmpty(this.get('name'))) { return ; }" — `findMembers` changes its empty-name sentinel from a resolved promise containing an empty list to bare `undefined`, breaking callers that rely on its asynchronous return contract.

confidence=75 severity=P2 app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:31 — "self.setProperties({" — Overlapping page requests mutate the same model without cancellation or generation checking, so a slower stale response can overwrite the members, count, and offset from the user's latest navigation.

confidence=75 severity=P2 app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — "limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i" — An unauthenticated caller can supply an arbitrarily large or negative limit, causing the public members endpoint to materialize and serialize an unbounded group membership list for denial of service.

confidence=100 severity=P1 spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — "xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42" — The automatic-group removal test bypasses the production DELETE route with PUT, so it can pass while the real endpoint rejects or misroutes the request.

confidence=100 severity=P1 spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:37 — "xhr :post, :create, name: \" bob \"" — The rewritten create test sends only a name and never verifies visible or alias_level, so the client/controller contract can silently discard user-selected group settings while the suite remains green.

confidence=100 severity=P1 spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:52 — "xhr :put, :update, id: 1, name: \"WAT\", visible: \"true\"" — Update coverage exercises only an automatic group, leaving the changed non-automatic name, alias_level, and visibility update contract completely unverified.

confidence=100 severity=P2 spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:56 — "group.name.should_not == \"WAT\"" — This negative assertion passes if the automatic group's name changes to any other incorrect value, so the test does not prove the original name is preserved.

confidence=75 severity=P2 spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:107 — "group.users.count.should == 2" — The add-members test checks only cardinality rather than the identities requested, so adding the wrong two users would satisfy the claimed behavior.
